gap: Identify which physical and latent feedback paths amplify the fast readout's fixed-wing 250 ms error before another fit.
roster: All 14 saved conditional origins and five 50 ms steps per case, including initial and extreme origins. Keep the readout fixed at each origin; use exact recorded future issued commands. Evaluate Jacobians on reconstructed measured carries and free-running carries.
measurement: Differentiate the full 50-dimensional one-step recurrence in physical tangent coordinates [world velocity, body rate, right SO(3) attitude] and the existing 41 latent coordinates. Also differentiate an exactly equal nominal step with the learned six-component body-acceleration output stop-gradiented at both midpoint substeps. Its derivative retains known gravity, force rotation, attitude integration, command filtering and history updates. Full minus stop-gradient isolates derivative paths through learned acceleration; this is a derivative attribution, not a new forecast model. Record physical 9x9 block partitions and five-step ordered products. Compare angular response to separate unit perturbations in initial velocity, rate and attitude. In the linearized products only, replace learned attitude-to-force/rate blocks by the known-propagation blocks, and separately zero latent-to-physical feedback. These interventions are local diagnostics, not counterfactual nonlinear forecasts or stability proofs.
checks: Authenticate every source manifest; reconstruct exact origin readouts; compare measured full Jacobians against the saved recurrence pack and float64 free forecasts against saved float32 conditional predictions. Verify tangent derivatives by centered finite differences at the first and middle origin of each case and arm. Require stop-gradient and full nominal steps to agree. Save every computed matrix and per-origin physical error. Recompute summary from saved output without fitting.
interpretation: Prefer the path that repeatedly explains excess 250 ms angular response and aligns with actual physical error. Local spectral radii, linear path deletion, and error association do not establish a unique causal mechanism. No vehicle-family branch, prior, strength sweep or adopted model change. If a matching simulator cannot branch from identical complete plant state, report that counterfactual truth is unavailable rather than treating saved Jacobians as truth.
